units.T-walk: A walk from a seed of the record, constrained to the record's label, spells a substring of the record at the expected position, or stops at a stated branch whose arms both carry the label.
units.T-longwalk: The gate's walk of a seed (300 to 5,000 bp under 60,000 ms, constrained to the record's column label) and its long twin, the same seed walked 10,000 bp under the same budget (budget_stress, outside the gate): each follows the record or stops at a stated branch, and a stop by the budget is stated within it. (unit property: to be written; this is the mapping's draft)
units.T-derived: A seed without explicit labels (permit per_hit) walks under the carrier set the host derives; a path follows the record.
units.T-end: A 31 bp seed near a record end: the walk stops at the record's end with the stated end reason.
units.T-repeat: A seed inside a multi-copy repeat: a branch is stated where the record's copies diverge, and a path of each copy is in the record.
units.T-labels: annotate mode lists every structural successor and a path follows the record; derived column / header labels hold the record's own label; max_labels_per_node 1 is echoed, the cut stated, the walk unchanged.
units.T-exhaustive: The exhaustive trie of radius 100: a leaf follows the record.
units.T-coords: trace with output coordinates: the reported positions equal the record's.
units.T-budget: Each bound (time, memory, work, steps) stops the walk with its own stated reason; the walk so far is in the record.
units.T-attempts: An expired not_after_ms is 409 before any work; an attempt_id states its usage and bound (409 duplicate when retained).
units.T-edge: Malformed seeds, unknown keys and out-of-range knobs are refused with the host's text; duplicate seeds are walked and marked; a budget above the cap is lowered and stated.
units.T-seeds: Three distinct seeds of three records in one request: each walk follows its own record.
units.T-graphlet: output.detail graphlet: the MGT body's walks follow the record.
units.T-caps: bounds.max_output_bp 50 per arm: the arm truncated by it says so; its walk is in the record.
units.T-quorum: min_live_labels 2 on a seed of one header label: every path ends below_min_labels at once (SPEC 6.4).
units.T-strand: The reverse complement of a unique window is not in this basic graph: the seed is refused.
